releaseNotes: Initial production release of JNSD Education Centre School ERP.
Student admission wizard with Aadhaar/Birth Certificate OCR scanning.
Daily class-wise attendance with bulk marking and registers.
Academic examination marks entry, automated totals, and CBSE report cards.
Manager-only fee management with receipt generation and receipt OCR reconciliation.
UDISE+ reporting preparation, field validation, and data export.
Staff management with secure teacher provisioning and instant revocation.
Full offline persistence with optional Supabase cloud synchronization.
